description: Add interaction to the tmux sidebar so windows and panes can be selected directly. Investigate practical options: mouse bindings, tmux choose-tree replacement, fzf popup driven from sidebar data, or a script that maps visible entries to tmux select-window/select-pane commands. Keep the sidebar read-only display as the fallback if true click support is too brittle. Acceptance: user can quickly jump to a listed window or pane from the sidebar workflow without typing raw tmux ids.
title: Make tmux sidebar clickable/selectable
